resources.string: Employee work-shift time tracking. The user explicitly starts a timer and the service keeps a monotonic elapsed-time counter plus a persistent notification for the whole shift, which can exceed 8 hours continuously — longer than the dataSync foreground service type is permitted to run under the Android 15 6h/24h cap. No data is collected from the device itself: no screen capture, no location, no accessibility service, no input monitoring.
Shown for the whole time a Trax timer is running. Tracking is never silent.
Tells you when a running timer was stopped by a reboot or by the system.
